setting.string: Send product photos to the GenMagic service
setting.help: This app needs the external GenMagic service (genmagic.co). When someone makes a photo, the product's main image and the style text (with any extra wishes typed in) are sent to GenMagic. Nothing is sent while this box is off.

The service is paid per photo from your own prepaid GenMagic balance. The app itself is free. Get a key at genmagic.co/get-api-key and add credit at genmagic.co/pricing. The key is stored as a system parameter that only administrators can read.
